day_shape: 67 items: US claims first operational suicide drone-boat strikes on Bandar Abbas and Qeshm, Trump vows 20% Hormuz toll, heavy Khamenei commemoration cycle at Tehran Prayer Ground, NYT reports failed Israeli plot to reinstall Ahmadinejad, UAE upgraded to Country Group A:5.

threads.label: US strikes and Hormuz blockade
threads.summary: Times of Israel published footage described as the first operational use of US suicide drone boats against Iran's Bandar Abbas naval base, and IRIB reported an American strike on Qeshm Island at 7pm. Tanker Trackers flagged a VLCC carrying 2 million barrels racing a 20:00 UTC blockade deadline, while Defa Press claimed Navy air defence downed a US drone over Bandar Abbas.

threads.label: Trump Hormuz toll and Gulf response
threads.summary: Iran International reported Trump saying the US will take over the Strait of Hormuz and seek compensation from regional states, with Jerusalem Post reporting Iran mocking the 20% fee proposal. Defa Press claimed 200 non-Iranian vessels had transited under an earlier arrangement before US-provoked tensions, and JPost reported several countries summoned Iranian ambassadors over recent strait strikes.

threads.label: Khamenei commemoration at Tehran Prayer Ground
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a sustained cycle around Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei's commemoration ceremony for the 'martyred leader' at Imam Khomeini's Prayer Ground, attended by President Pezeshkian, with crowds chanting 'Avenger, avenge'. Khamenei's office posted a message pledging not to abandon 'criminal aggressors' and to demand reparations and blood money.

threads.label: Ahmadinejad plot and hardliner turn
threads.summary: Times of Israel cited a New York Times report that Israel ran a multi-year effort to recruit and reinstall former president Ahmadinejad, and Iran International reported parliament voted two outspoken critics of US talks out of senior National Security Committee posts. Iran International also reported hardliners openly arguing for political assassinations as a legitimate tool.

threads.label: Lebanon-Israel Rome talks, Hezbollah
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Lebanon and Israel resumed direct talks in Rome, with Lebanon seeking IDF withdrawal and Israel seeking Hezbollah disarmament, while Netanyahu told the Negev Conference Hezbollah retains only 7–8% of its pre-war missile stock. A group of Israeli settler activists including four minors briefly crossed into Lebanon near Ghajar before being escorted back by the IDF.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthis and Red Sea
threads.summary: The UN Security Council convened its 10194th meeting to vote on extending the Secretary-General's monthly reporting on Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping to 15 January 2027. Jerusalem Post ran an analysis alleging Iran is using the Houthis to close Bab el-Mandeb, and reported an attack on Sanaa International Airport during an attempted Mahan Air landing.

threads.label: Iran-linked overseas surveillance and threats
threads.summary: Iran International cited an FT report that US military personnel and contractors in the Middle East were targeted by a coordinated phone-tracking campaign during the Iran war, and Handelsblatt reported German authorities investigating suspected Iran-linked surveillance and attack preparations. Jerusalem Post reported an Iranian regime-linked channel posting an AI-generated Lego video claiming responsibility for Senator Lindsey Graham's death and threatening other US figures.

events.summary_en: Khosropanah: If it were not for the women of Ashura, the name of Karbala and Imam Husayn would not have endured in history. The secretary of the Supreme Council of the Cultural Revolution, emphasising the unparalleled role of women in perpetuating the message of Ashura, said: If the women of Ashura, particularly Hazrat Zaynab, Hazrat Rubab and other women present and involved in the Karbala movement had not existed, the name of Imam Husayn and the event of Ashura would not have endured in history, and these women were the true messengers of the Husayni movement. Ashura literature is not limited to Persian and Arabic languages, but numerous poems have been composed in English, French, Malay and other world languages about the martyrs of Karbala and the actors of this movement, which demonstrates the universal nature of the message

The eldest son of the martyred leader of the revolution: This great calamity is a matter of patience as stated in the Holy Quran and blessed are the patient. events.title: Security Council, 10194th Meeting (AM) Yemen
events.summary: At 10 a.m., the Council will vote on a draft resolution extending the monthly reporting requirement for the Secretary-General on attacks by the Houthis in Yemen on merchant and commercial vessels in the Red Sea. The text extends the reporting obligation - established by resolution 2722 (2024) and last renewed through resolution 2812 (2026) - for another six months, until 15 January 2027.

events.title_en: Hojjat al-Islam Shirazi: We are ready for the destruction of global disbelief
events.summary_en: Hojjat al-Islam Shirazi: We are ready for the destruction of global disbelief. The head of ideological and political affairs of the Revolutionary Guards said: The martyred leader of the revolution had said that the Zionist regime would not see the next 25 years; now if the enemies are hurrying to realise this fate, we too are ready and fully prepared for the destruction of global disbelief. If we are to fight for another 10 years, we are ready. The Iranian people showed during the Sacred Defence that they stood firm against the Baathist regime for eight years, whilst at that time many said Iran did not have sufficient capabilities and weapons, and in some cases this claim was true. At that time, there was no knowledge of today's missile capability, nor of the drones and advanced equipment we have now.

events.title_en: Inscribed: We will not abandon the criminal aggressors
events.summary_en: Inscribed: We will not abandon the criminal aggressors. An excerpt from the message of Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution: God willing, we will certainly not abandon the criminal aggressors who attacked our country. We will certainly demand reparations for every damage incurred and the blood money of the martyrs and the compensation of the disabled from this war, and we will certainly take the management of the Strait of Hormuz to a new stage. events.title: A Hamas commander and three other operatives were killed in separate strikes in the Gaza Strip yesterday, the military announces. A separate strike in northern Gaza killed three armed Hamas gunmen who the military says were advancing attacks on troops. "The terrorists posed an imminent threat to the troops and were eliminated in precise aerial strikes," the IDF adds.

events.title: Enhanced Favorable Treatment for the United Arab Emirates Under the Export Administration Regulations
events.summary: In this final rule, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) to provide enhanced favorable treatment for the United Arab Emirates (UAE). Specifically, BIS is removing the UAE from Country Groups D:3 and D:4 and adding the UAE to Country Group A:5. More license exceptions will now be available, including Strategic Trade Authorization (STA) for the UAE Government and approved commercial entities in the UAE. STA will authorize the export, reexport, or transfer (in-country) of military items; certain commercial satellites and spacecraft; and dual-use items useful in, inter alia, oil and gas production, desalination, and civil nuclear power generation. The UAE Government and approved commercial entities will also have license-free access to advanced computing items, consistent with the May 2025 U.S.-UAE Artificial Intelligence Cooperation framework, without compromising U.S. digital infrastructure buildout.
